text:
"Marta Nguyen (Hypernova): Hey team — Hypernova is ready to onboard a custom multilingual summarizer (en/es/fr/pt). We need a Private deployment (VPC) with customer-managed KMS/HSM, PHI-safe handling, and model version pinning. Model is a 13B finetune on our internal docs. Primary asks: 1) safety checks for PHI redaction and logging controls, 2) an eval plan (quality + hallucination/PHI leakage tests), 3) performance SLO: p50 latency <=200ms at ~2 rps sustained, 4) cost targets (want guidance on quantization + batching), and 5) timeline for canary + production. Any immediate blockers?"

"Priya (CSM): Thanks @Marta — forwarding to eng + safety. Quick checklist from our side:
- Private deployment + KMS: ✅ (need KMS ARN and network CIDR)
- Eval dataset: please share sample set (300-500 docs) and desired metrics
- Compliance: will route to Riley for PHI policy
- Renewal note: call this a potential Dedicated-to-Private upsell — I'll flag for renewal risk if timeline slips :warning:
Next step: can we get a sample eval bundle this week?" 

"Ethan (SolutionsEng): @Marta great — couple quick Qs:
1) Can you confirm max sequence length (tokens)?
2) Do you expect streaming responses or batch summarization calls? (affects runtime)
3) Any latency spikes acceptable during warmup?

Also please upload a zipped eval set (S3 link or similar). We'll run our standard quality + hallucination harness and provide a template with metrics.

For perf: assuming 13B quantized to 4-bit it should meet latencies on one A10G-class node for that load, but need exact seq len + batch shape.

Sample model config we usually try first:
```yaml
model_name: hypernova-13b-v1
private_deploy: true
kms_key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
max_seq: 2048
quantization: nf4-4bit
slo_p50_ms: 200
slo_rps: 2
safety_profile: phi-redact-v1
```" 

"Marta Nguyen (Hypernova): Answers:
- max_seq typically 1024 (most docs short, some 1800 tokens)
- mostly synchronous single-doc summarize calls (no streaming)
- warmup spikes ok up to 350ms for first 5 minutes after deploy

S3 eval link (redacted public placeholder): https://s3.company.com/hypernova/evals/multilang-sample-v1.zip
Note: Legal approved sending unmasked PHI for private-on-prem evals under our DPA/BAA. We can also send a masked copy if you prefer.

Also we need logs to avoid storing raw user text in long-term storage (30 day retention max)." 

"Riley (Safety): Thanks @Marta — high-level safety asks:
- PHI taxonomy needed (what categories are considered PHI for you). Send as CSV if possible.
- For redaction: do you want model to abstain or to redact and summarize the redacted segments? We recommend redaction + explicit marker for traceability.
- Eval guidance: include adversarial prompts and back-channel probes (we will run injection tests).
- Logging: we can support ephemerally logged requests for eval in Private (no long-term storage) but need KMS + customer signing.

If you can share the PHI taxonomy and an example policy doc, we’ll map to our safety checks.

Also tagging this thread for legal review if needed. :eyes:" 

"Marta Nguyen (Hypernova): Sending PHI taxonomy now (CSV attached to S3 bundle). Legal OK with ephemeral eval logs and KMS. Timeline: we'd like a canary in 3 weeks and prod in 6 weeks. Is that feasible on your side? We're evaluating renewal timing and want to avoid risk if onboarding slips past quarter end." 

"Priya (CSM): Can do — timeline looks reasonable but depends on a couple things:
- Solutions team confirms canary perf window (Ethan)
- Safety sign-off after adversarial testing (Riley)

I'll mark this as 'onboarding: high priority' in the renewal tracker and set a checkpoint next Tues. If anything slips, I'll raise renewal CSM-flag so AM can start contract extension convo early. :white_check_mark:" 

"Ethan (SolutionsEng): Canary plan — propose:
1) Week 1: ingest eval set + run quality/halluc tests (ours)
2) Week 2: private staging deploy + perf tuning (quant + batching)
3) Week 3: 48h canary at target load, smoke safety tests
We need a small token budget for perf runs (~100k tokens) and the S3 eval bundle. I'll open infra ticket for private cluster provisioning.

Adding the infra-bot: infra-bot, please provision a private cluster stub for org hypernova (A10G x1) — tag: hs-onboard-3519876543" 

"infra-bot: Ticket created #INF-8891 — provisioning started. ETA ~48h. Logs will be posted in #eng-infra. :gear:" 

"Marta Nguyen (Hypernova): Got it — sending token budget approval and confirming S3 link contains PHI taxonomy + sample docs. Thanks all — looking forward to the canary plan. :rocket:" 

"Priya (CSM): I'll schedule the checkpoint and share an onboarding checklist (internal) + customer-facing timeline. We'll also capture feedback during canary for PS/enablement docs.

Next steps summary:
- Hypernova: confirm KMS ARN + grant access to infra team
- Hypernova: confirm token budget approval (reply in thread)
- Solutions: ingest eval + run initial QA
- Safety: run PHI DIAG + adversarial tests
- CSM: schedule checkpoint and flag renewal risk if timeline slips

Thanks — looping in AM if needed. :handshake:" 

"Marta Nguyen (Hypernova): KMS ARN shared in S3 perms and token budget approved. Please proceed."
